mythologySignificance:
Central Siliguri Shiva temple for local Hindi–Bengali devotees.

Classical pilgrimage teaching places Shiv Mandir, Siliguri within India’s tirtha network: a location where devotion to Lord Shiva is believed to ripen vows more readily than in ordinary space. Epic, Puranic, and regional mahatmya literature — not a single uniform text — sustain this sense of sacred geography.
